item.title: Ex-UK envoy to US Mandelson arrested over suspicions of ‘misconduct in public office’
item.description: Newly released emails show Labour kingpin shared information with his friend, sex-offender Jeffrey Epstein, when he was a minister in the British government The post Ex-UK envoy to US Mandelson arrested over suspicions of ‘misconduct in public office’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Hamas seen working to maintain control of Gaza via Trump-backed bodies
item.description: Documents show terror group moving armed-wing chiefs into civil roles that will let it hold power via technocratic administration, while also girding for fresh round against Israel The post Hamas seen working to maintain control of Gaza via Trump-backed bodies appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Man shot and killed in northern Arab town as deadly crime keeps surging
item.description: Wael Saeida, 21, killed outside bakery in Shibli-Umm al-Ghanem, northern Galilee; Herzog tells Israeli Muslim leaders that crime wave has led to 'state of emergency' The post Man shot and killed in northern Arab town as deadly crime keeps surging appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Ben Gvir’s National Guard operating without directives or oversight, Knesset finds

item.title: Board of Peace said looking into ‘stablecoin’ to boost economy of postwar Gaza
